name: gate-early-stop-two-blocks
reason: The two-block early stop of timing and memory sessions replayed on every 30-pair session of evidence sets armv7-thumb2-3df7ae6d-linux-armv7, runners-gate-build-linux-arm64, mpegts-pes-gate-build-linux-arm64 and isobmff-armv7-runtime-regate-linux-arm64, and simulated by drawing pairs from the ARMv7 sessions' own ratios with the true median at, beyond and inside each ceiling; the independence of their pairs (lag-1 autocorrelation and first-block shift against each session's shuffled ratios); a simulation of the looks after 10 and 20 pairs and of the two-block rule under autocorrelated and drifting pairs; the per-case comparisons of the real runs in gate-early-stop-runs-aarch64 and gate-early-stop-runs-armv7; and the scripts
